name: spreadsheetAutoSizeColumn
description: Sets a column of the active sheet to auto-fit its contents. Rows and columns are 1-based. Because a headless engine has no font-metrics renderer, the workbook is written with Excel's best-fit flag and the spreadsheet application computes the exact pixel width when the file is opened. The fluent member form is autoSizeColumn(column) and autoSize() does the same for every column.

examples.title: Auto-size the name column
